title: When cascadeBlock runs
question: Under which condition does executeReviewAction() call cascadeBlock() after a rating?
concept: Only on rating 1 for a token that has at least one prerequisite.

title: Effect on the failed card
question: What happens to the card of the token that received rating 1?
concept: blocked = 1; it leaves the queue until unblockReady releases it.

title: Direct foundations materialised
question: For which prerequisites does cascadeBlock() create missing cards?
concept: For the direct prerequisites of the failed token, not the transitive hull.

title: When unblockReady releases
question: When does unblockReady() release a blocked card?
concept: Every direct prerequisite has a card with reps ≥ 1 that is itself not blocked; release cascades in the same call.

title: Blocking is not evaluateRating
question: Why is blocking not part of evaluateRating()?
concept: FSRS arithmetic and learning-path policy stay separate.

title: No proactive admission gate
question: Does an unmet prerequisite block access before the card is ever asked?
concept: No; hard edges are not a proactive admission gate.
